summary: A MIDI controller firmware for the FM-1 and M-VAVE's SMK-37 keyboards that names the chord you hold in large type, lets you map every control on screen and sends over USB and Bluetooth MIDI. It makes no sound itself.
features: Big chord and note-name display from keys or incoming MIDI
On-screen MAP: each control sends CC, note, program or pitch bend
Arpeggiator, chord memory, scale snap and a two-zone keyboard split
Key LEDs coloured from MIDI on channel 16
USB and BLE MIDI out; FM-1 keys send fixed velocity 100
No web installer or emulator; packages per device model

headings: map a control on the screen
